implementation.operation: CPU Hadamard, public C++ domain and scaling unchanged
implementation.native_bridge: Real unary GGML_OP_CUSTOM callback reuses the existing native FWHT arithmetic body; no dummy matrix, null W-squared storage, numerical kernel rewrite, or log-W operation graph.
implementation.reference_semantics: The unary CUSTOM always means FWHT under either use_ref value. The original hinted MUL_MAT still owns a real matrix and preserves its genuine matrix reference fallback.
implementation.ownership: The callback comes from the selected baseline/AVX2 CpuProgram. The module and compute callback share the actual selected owner; no new per-invocation globals or scratch state.
implementation.metadata_capacity: Existing capacity retained: matrix-plus-MUL_MAT becomes one unary CUSTOM, with the same possible dtype casts.
